newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police seize hashish shipment, arrest 14.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police seize hashish shipment, arrest 14.

text.p: Fourteen people were detained after 3,000 kg (6,600 lb) of hashish was found hidden aboard a British yacht during a raid in southern Spain, police said on Monday.

Civil Guard officers said the drugs with a street value of around nine billion pesetas ($68 million) were found after they intercepted the boat early on Sunday as it drifted suspiciously off the coast of Huelva province.
The 107-package haul was believed to have originated in Morocco for shipment to central European countries, they said.
They detained a Britain, Swede and German on the yacht and 11 Spaniards on land were suspected of waiting to receive the drugs. The foreigners were identified by initials only.
